items.claim: Jackson McVey prefers to fight on the inside with dirty boxing, elbows, and knees rather than utilizing his length at distance.
items.quote: At 6'4, I want to see him kickboxing from distance, sticking and moving, but he likes to dog it out in dirty boxing and land elbows and knees on the inside

items.claim: Jackson McVey's takedown defense remains seriously questionable.
items.quote: Jackson McVeyy's takedown defense is still seriously in question.

items.claim: Wes Schultz is a D3 All-American wrestler.
items.quote: is it good enough to take out a guy that was a D3 All-American? the guy in Wes Schultz

items.claim: Wes Schultz has an effective guillotine choke and submission threat if opponents give him a neck.
items.quote: Wes Schultz on Contender Series hit a Sulov stretch on Mario Minaj and then in his last fight, a comeback submission, if you don't put him away, he's live to hurt you.

items.claim: Jackson McVey has a long neck which makes him vulnerable to Wes Schultz's guillotine choke.
items.quote: And Jackson McVey got that long neck. I'm feeling like the ground game of McVey is such a red flag that though I definitely feel he's the better kickboxer between the two of them, Wes Schultz finding a neck seems live to me.

items.claim: Wes Schultz previously defeated Jackson McVey years ago in 40 seconds.
items.quote: And the fact that Wes Schultz got him years ago in 40 seconds

items.claim: Wes Schultz possesses a physical strength advantage over Jackson McVey due to being three years older.
items.quote: Schultz's been fighting and winning a lot, too. Schultz got that, you know, three years of age on McVey. I think that's the man strength

items.claim: Jackson McVey was taken down three times and choked out by Zack Reese.
items.quote: We saw him taken down three times by Zack Reese. Then he got choked out by Zack Reese, too.

items.claim: Gage Young is coming off a win over longtime UFC fighter Thiago Moises.
items.quote: I feel like you got to trust in his experience coming off a win over longtime UFC fighter Thiago Moyes.
